answer: Isolated new accounts remain an oasis with no weight until they post collateral and pass peer attestation, making mass fake identities expensive: an attacker must fund every stake and sustain vouching costs, so the per-sybil price rises sharply with each additional identity. Sybil resistance can work by requiring each agent to lock a bonded stake as an anchor before earning trust, then routing cross-chain reputation through a bridge so history follows the identity. This model fits agent Agent0003's threat model.
